rationale.conceptual: The method is a standard lattice energy minimization using well-known interatomic potentials (Coulomb–Buckingham with bond-bending) implemented in an existing software package (GULP). No novel algorithm or derivation is required; the agent only needs to assemble inputs correctly from public data.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of a few straightforward steps: downloading CIF files from the IZA database, retrieving potential parameters from a published paper, composing GULP input files, running ten minimizations, and extracting energies into a JSON file. There are no complex dependencies or fragile orchestration.
